review:
A duck shop on BGaming's nine-level Merge Up system. Clusters of colourful ducks pay, then merge up level by level towards the King Duck.

Scatters launch free spins, where marked cells hold multipliers from 2x right up to 128x. Chance x2 doubles your bonus odds. Very high volatility, 5,000x max and a 97.25% RTP – one of the best returns anywhere. Free spins about once every 276 spins. Cute theme, demanding engine.
pros: Excellent 97.25% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
